name: Midlantic Property Management
what_they_do: Full-service property management for community associations, condos/townhome communities, apartment complexes, commercial and waterfront properties, in business since 1995. Services listed include administrative management, financial/audit management, on-site services, association websites and a STATCOM emergency alert service. It states it is a CAI Accredited Association Management Company (AAMC) with offices in Highland Park and Long Branch.
customers: HOA and condo association boards and property owners (business-to-business, not individual renters)

size_signals.signal: Two offices named (Highland Park and Long Branch, NJ); operating since 1995
CAI Accredited Association Management Company (AAMC) designation claimed
No staff named; single general contact email jimp@mpm-nj.com; office hours Mon-Fri 9:00-4:30
47 Google reviews at 1.6 stars - high review volume for a local PM firm (inference: sizable book of associations)

website_review.primary_cta: No real CTA; nav has Contact Us and Proposal Request links only, no button
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: No - Proposal Request page tells the visitor to phone or email a list of 10 fields by hand
website_review.trust_signals: AAMC accreditation claim, 'since 1995' text, stock call-centre photo; no photos of managed properties, no testimonials, no named staff
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Free Weebly subdomain rather than own domain; footer '@2013. All Rights Reserved'; no h1 on home page; no meta description; template branding 'The Community - It's Time to Stand Out' still visible
website_review.search_basics: Titles name the company and page but not the town; no meta description; service sub-pages exist but are thin; no schema markup
top_issues: No contact or quote form anywhere; proposal requests require phoning or writing a manual email
Phone number is plain text with no tel: link, so no tap-to-call on mobile
Site reads as abandoned: free Weebly subdomain, (c) 2013 footer, no h1, no meta description
Google Business Profile has no hours (Google shows 'Add business hours') and sits at 1.6 stars over 47 reviews with no visible response strategy

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt only disallows /ajax/ and /apps/, so Googlebot/OAI-SearchBot/PerplexityBot are not blocked. GBP exists with address/phone but Google prompts 'Add business hours' and 'Add missing information'. Hours and services are plain text, but no price ranges, no service-area statement, and zero JSON-LD. Nothing is bookable or submittable online, so an agent must hand off to a phone call.

operations_signals.signal: All intake runs through a phone number and one personal email (jimp@mpm-nj.com); proposals require a phone call or hand-written email
Public review sentiment is heavily negative across 47 Google reviews (complaints about how association money is spent and service levels) with no visible owner responses
Site maintains separate 'Submit a Work Order' and 'STATCOM emergency alert' pages, implying steady resident-request volume

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the email-only proposal request with a real online quote/management-proposal intake form using the 10 fields already listed, with auto-acknowledgement and follow-up
top_opportunities.evidence: Proposal Request page instructs visitors to phone or manually email association name, address, contact, units and property type; the site has no form element

top_opportunities.opportunity: Reputation recovery workflow: automated review requests to satisfied boards plus drafted owner responses on Google
top_opportunities.evidence: Google profile shows 1.6 stars over 47 reviews with complaints about spending and service; no responses visible

top_opportunities.opportunity: Agent-ready cleanup: own domain, GBP hours, LocalBusiness JSON-LD, service pages naming towns, tel: links
top_opportunities.evidence: Free Weebly subdomain, (c) 2013 footer, no meta description, no JSON-LD, no tel: links, no GBP hours

scores.reasons: Gap: 2013-era free Weebly site with no form, no click-to-call and no structured data, plus a 1.6-star profile. Ability to pay: manages a multi-town association portfolio on recurring fees, so a 5-figure fix is plausible (inference). Ease: top fix is one form plus schema/domain cleanup. Evidence: pages, robots.txt and Google panel all checked directly.

wrong_claims.claim: Template branding 'The Community - It's Time to Stand Out' is still visible on the site
wrong_claims.what_is_true: Not present in the home page HTML or on the contact/proposal pages checked; the header reads 'The Community Association Specialists'. The rest of the 'abandoned site' evidence (free Weebly subdomain, '@2013. All Rights Reserved.', no h1, no meta description) is all correct.
The site has a 'Meet the President' page and the About page is signed H. James Polos, President - one named person, though no broader staff list.
